units.source_text: 薰大将靠在东面的栏杆上，在夕阳中眺望庭院里渐次开放的秋花。

en.t: General Kaoru leaned against the railing on the east side, gazing in the evening sun at the autumn flowers gradually opening in the garden.

units.source_text: 不堪忧伤之情，低声吟诵白居易的诗句“大抵四时心总苦，就中肠断是秋天”。

en.t: Unable to bear his sorrow, he softly recited Bai Juyi's lines: "In all four seasons the heart is mostly bitter; among them, autumn breaks the heart most."

units.source_text: 忽闻女子衣衫窸窣之声，分明是刚才背转身子吟诗的那个人，她穿过正殿的门，走向那边去了。

en.t: Suddenly he heard the rustle of a woman's robes; it was clearly the person who had just turned her back and recited the poem, and she passed through the main hall's door and went off that way.

units.source_text: 此时匂亲王走过来，问侍女们：“适才从这里走到那边去的是谁？”

en.t: Just then Prince Niou came over and asked the ladies-in-waiting, "Who was it who just went from here over there?"

units.source_text: 有一侍女答道：“是大公主那里的侍女中将君。”

en.t: One lady-in-waiting answered, "It was Chujo no Kimi, a lady serving the elder princess."

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“这也未免太不谨慎了。

en.t: General Kaoru thought, "That is far too careless.

units.source_text: 对于怀着好奇心探问的男人，怎么可以随随便便地公然把名字告诉他！”

en.t: How could anyone openly tell the name so casually to a man who is asking out of curiosity!"

units.source_text: 他替这女子抱屈。

en.t: He felt indignant on the woman's behalf.

units.source_text: 看见众侍女对匂亲王都很亲近，又觉得嫉妒。

en.t: Seeing that all the ladies-in-waiting were so familiar with Prince Niou, he also felt jealous.

units.source_text: 想道：“想必是匂亲王态度强硬，所以众侍女只得服帖。

en.t: He thought, "Prince Niou must be forceful in his manner, so the ladies-in-waiting have no choice but to yield to him.

units.source_text: 我真倒霉，为了匂亲王的狂恋，一直妒恨忧伤，不知吃了多少苦头。

en.t: How unlucky I am; because of Prince Niou's mad passion, I have gone on suffering jealousy, resentment, and grief, enduring hardships beyond measure.

units.source_text: 这些侍女之中，定有品貌不凡的女子，是他所倾心热恋的。

en.t: Among these ladies-in-waiting there must be some woman of extraordinary grace and beauty whom he loves with all his heart.

units.source_text: 我将设法诱惑这女子，占为己有，让他也尝一尝我这种苦头的滋味吧。

en.t: I will find a way to entice that woman and make her mine, so that he too may taste the bitterness I have suffered.

units.source_text: 真正有思虑的女子，一定倾向我这方面。

en.t: A woman with true judgment would surely incline toward me.

units.source_text: 然而这种人不易多得。

en.t: Yet such women are not easily found in any number.

units.source_text: 这就使我想起那二女公子来。

en.t: This makes me think of the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 她常嫌匂亲王的行为不适合他的身份，又明知我和她的恋情不便公开，被世人讥评起来也不好听，然而对我的友爱之情始终不曾放弃。

en.t: She often disapproved of Prince Niou's conduct as unworthy of his rank, and though she knew that her love with me could not be made public and would sound disgraceful if people criticized it, she never abandoned her affection for me.

units.source_text: 能有这等见识，实在是世间难得的贤女。

en.t: To possess such discernment is truly the mark of a wise woman rare in this world.

units.source_text: 这许多侍女之中有否这样的人呢？

en.t: Is there anyone like that among all these ladies-in-waiting?

units.source_text: 我对她们生疏，不得而知了。

en.t: I am unfamiliar with them, so I have no way of knowing.

units.source_text: 近来寂寞无聊，夜寝不能安枕，让我来学习一下，也干一些风流逸事吧。”

en.t: Lately I have been lonely and bored, unable to sleep peacefully at night; let me learn a little from him and try some romantic adventure myself."

units.source_text: 他现在这样想，也是不适合他的身份的。

en.t: For him to think this way now was also unbefitting his rank.
